camel_example: aliyun eipanycast TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'aeip-2zeerraiwb7ujsxdc0000' --Tag.1.Key FinanceDept --Tag.1.Value FinanceJoshua --ResourceType ANYCASTEIPADDRESS
description_en: Creates and attaches tags to specified resources
description_zh: 调用TagResources接口为指定的资源统一创建并绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun eipanycast tag-resources --resource-id aeip-2zeerraiwb7ujsxdc0000 --resource-type ANYCASTEIPADDRESS --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en: The resource ID. You can specify up to 20 resource IDs
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID，最多支持输入20个资源ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to ANYCASTEIPADDRESS
parameters.name: resource_type

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You must specify at least one tag key and at most 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

When you call this operation, you must specify the Tag.N.Key parameter
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。至少输入1个标签键，最多支持输入20个标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

调用该API时，Tag.N.Key参数必须输入
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You must specify at least one tag value and at most 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

When you call this operation, you must specify the Tag.N.Value parameter
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。至少输入1个标签值，最多支持输入20个标签值。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

调用该API时，Tag.N.Value参数必须输入
fields.name: value

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: The call is successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
